criteria.task: Build a register table for the original adapter: address/offset, permitted width, reset value, writable/reserved masks and read/write effects. Reject a 16 bit access to a 32 bit-only control register and preserve state on rejection.

delayed.task: Change the peripheral revision's reserved-bit policy and identify code/mask tests that must change.

criteria.task: Model status 15 with W1C acknowledgment5, yielding10, and a DATA read that consumes one byte. Compare a broken read-modify-write acknowledgment with a direct mask write while another flag arrives.

delayed.task: Add a read-to-clear status register and redesign diagnostics so inspecting status does not accidentally acknowledge it twice.

criteria.task: Derive a controller state machine from the selected register sequence with guards, writes, wait budgets and terminal outputs. Feed ready, stalled and illegal-order traces and reject a data write before readiness.

delayed.task: Replace polling with interrupts while preserving the same state transitions and ownership rules.

criteria.task: Implement a documented volatile register adapter with explicit widths and offsets, then inspect generated loads/stores and structure-offset assertions. Keep host simulation behind function calls rather than casting host RAM into evidence of device semantics.

delayed.task: Change compiler or endianness and rerun the offset/access-width audit before reusing the adapter.

criteria.task: Separate four claims for one transfer: observable compiler access, atomic hardware transaction, CPU ordering and ownership synchronization. Give a counterexample where volatile status polling does not publish ordinary payload safely.

delayed.task: Move the payload to another core's cached memory and derive added publication/coherency requirements.

criteria.task: Start ODR at 3, schedule an interrupt setting bit3 between a foreground ODR read and write, and demonstrate the lost update. Repair the foreground bit2 set/bit0 reset using BSRR; reject overlapping masks by the service policy.

delayed.task: Allow the interrupt to write the entire ODR and explain why BSRR cannot enforce application-level ownership against that conflicting writer.

criteria.task: Produce a pin table separating mode, alternate-function selection, output type, pull and verified board routing. Model an open-drain bus and reject driving an unknown external circuit or assuming an internal pull satisfies electrical requirements.

delayed.task: Move the service to another package where the same peripheral uses a different available pin mapping.

criteria.task: Implement one BSRR transaction for a set/reset mask, verifying no ODR read and no unrelated-bit modification in the adapter log. Test bit15, empty mask and rejected out-of-range/overlap input.

delayed.task: Require a synchronized multi-port update and explain why per-port BSRR cannot supply cross-port atomicity.

criteria.task: Implement a stable-sample debounce state machine over samples0,1,0,1,1,1 with threshold3, then compare edge interrupt notification and polling. Count one accepted transition and define initialization/overflow behavior.

delayed.task: Replace fixed-rate sampling with irregular timestamps and derive a duration-based filter instead of reusing a sample count.
